description: Triggers a new simulation run with the current canvas state and settings, refreshing the signal data.

link.description: BlockWerk share link (https://blockwerk.tech/?project=…) of the diagram, as returned by an earlier result. The connector rebuilds the diagram from it when it holds no diagram of its own.

reason.description: User-facing explanation of why settings were changed (e.g., Nyquist constraint)

sampleTime.description: Optional custom step size (dt) for high frequency or stiff systems (e.g., 0.001)

title: Run simulation
